text: Dream: reviewing while activity is warm cuts review latency
description: Order the review inbox by activity warmth, so the human reviews work while the agent's trace is fresh. Smallest experiment: first measure the current review → implemented latency from git history (read-only). Disconfirming: no latency change after ordering by warmth; risk: old items get buried.

status.comment: Premise changed 2026-11-01: the review queue went from 197 to 1 (commit 708a52af) because verified work now goes straight to implemented and review is only for the human's own judgment. Question for Felix: with a near-empty review queue, is ordering it by activity warmth still worth an experiment, or cancel?
